findings.mobile: At375px the A/B labels and57px-native numerical result lines remain distinguishable. Fixed captions explain the values. No result line or caption is cut off.

findings.observed: The diagram explicitly states one chance to shoot and remaining enemy HP90. A100≥90 is sufficient in one hit, B40<90 is insufficient. Misses/armor excluded and illustrative-not-measured disclosure are present beside the evidence and in captions.

Actual ACVI still is paired with Boost Speed306→320 and QB EN Consumption480→560. Quick Boost/QB terminology and gain/sacrifice meaning appear. Caption and slide explicitly distinguish menu-stat comparison from measured movement speed.

BOTW Armor category is named with a hollow category focus, then the mark clears before later world-only samples. Monster Hunter grid focus encloses actual body-part icons without covering right equipment detail or fixed captions. Grid mark clears at its recorded boundary. Character/detail/menu states change between sampled frames; this is sampled boundary evidence, not continuous tracking approval.

Actual armor menu still leads to an icon→detail→character-preview diagram. Sorting/정렬 is explained as reordering by criterion. Initial list12/8/10 becomes descending12/10/8 without changing the candidate values; narrowed-candidate continuation retains12/10/8. The list is explicitly labelled illustrative, with fictional equipment/numbers.
findings.mobile: Three rows, matching weapon icons, values and direction arrow remain separated at375px. White caption panels do not overlap the lists or lower disclosure.

findings.observed: The stages 기준→후보→시작할 조합 begin unselected, distinguish attack focus versus cold preparation, then show selecting attack focus, narrowing candidates and filling the starting combination. Later a boot is directly replaced with 부츠B. The slide expressly says this is explanatory UI and does not reproduce a particular game auto-equip feature. Captions additionally disclaim calculating a universal best answer.
findings.mobile: Stages, arrows, selected goal, equipped icons and orange changed boot stay distinct at375px; no stage label or caption clipping observed.

findings.observed: All visible white boxed captions in this part remain in the fixed lower area, have at most two lines and retain visible outer clearance. No clipped glyph, off-frame box, diagram/caption collision or editorial-mark overlap with captions found in108 sampled frame states. Source/game credits remain at the top. Board-only yellow context text may truncate at cell edges; it is outside the encoded video and is not a subtitle defect.

No unexpected black/error/blank source frame found at these before/first/after samples. Captions do not jump position across cuts. The03→04 transition carries equipment differences into finding equipment;04→05 retains narrowed candidates into choosing a starting combination;05→06 carries the chosen combination into testing. Intentional narrator gaps have no stale caption/mark. Continuous motion and audio joins still need their separate actual playback/listening evidence.
